name: freecad-mcp
description: Control FreeCAD from Claude: create and edit models, run Python scripts, inspect documents and run FEM analyses.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a running FreeCAD through the FreeCAD MCP addon.

**Requirements**
- FreeCAD with the FreeCAD MCP addon installed (the Windows installer does this for you) and its RPC server started from the *FreeCAD MCP* toolbar.
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on this computer. Claude Desktop runs the server through uv, which downloads Python 3.12 or later and the server's dependencies automatically. The first start can take about half a minute.

The RPC connection defaults to localhost. Use the settings below for a remote FreeCAD, an auth token, text-only feedback, or a custom FreeCADCmd for headless scripts.

tools.name: reload_document
tools.description: Close and reopen a saved document to pick up external file changes.

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Create an object in a document.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object from a document.

tools.name: get_objects
tools.description: Get all objects in a document.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Get one object in a document.

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Get a screenshot of the active view.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Execute Python code on FreeCAD's GUI thread.

tools.name: execute_code_async
tools.description: Start a background computation and return its job ID.

tools.name: get_async_status
tools.description: Get background job state and failure tracebacks.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Poll a timed-out GUI operation without waiting for the GUI thread.

tools.name: execute_code_headless
tools.description: Run a script in a separate headless FreeCAD process.

tools.name: get_rpc_status
tools.description: Report RPC and GUI-dispatch health, addon version and version check.

tools.name: insert_part_from_library
tools.description: Insert a part from the FreeCAD parts library.

tools.name: get_parts_list
tools.description: List parts in the FreeCAD parts library.

tools.name: run_fem_analysis
tools.description: Run CalculiX on an existing FEM analysis and return summary results.

host.title: FreeCAD RPC host
host.description: Host of the FreeCAD RPC server. Keep localhost unless FreeCAD runs on another machine with remote connections enabled.

auth_token.title: RPC auth token
auth_token.description: Only needed if you set an auth token in the FreeCAD MCP toolbar. Leave empty otherwise.

only_text_feedback.title: Text-only feedback
only_text_feedback.description: Omit screenshots from tool results to reduce token use.

freecadcmd.title: FreeCADCmd executable (optional)
freecadcmd.description: Used by execute_code_headless. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, then the default Windows install folders).
